hints.title: How to get a motor from the hardware map
hints.content: Use `DcMotor myMotor = hardwareMap.get(DcMotor.class, "testMotor");` to get a reference to the motor. The name must match exactly.

hints.title: How to set motor power
hints.content: Call `myMotor.setPower(0.5);` on your motor variable. The value ranges from -1.0 (full reverse) to 1.0 (full forward).

hints.title: Where should I get the motor?
hints.content: Always get hardware references before `waitForStart()` so any configuration errors show up during initialization, not during the match.
